name: Akroma
title: The Angel of Wrath
role: Reality-sculpted angel and adversary of Phage
summary: Created by Ixidor in grief, Akroma became a symbol of vengeance whose conflict with Phage culminated in Karona.
biography: Akroma was a powerful angel made real by Ixidor after the death of Nivea in the Cabal pits.
Her purpose was vengeance against Phage, Jeska's transformed identity. Their confrontation grew beyond a personal feud as competing supporters rallied to them.
Kamahl's Soul Reaper strike joined Akroma, Phage, and Zagorka into Karona. Akroma died when that composite being was later broken apart.

featuredCard.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
featuredCard.significance: The original Legions depiction of the angel created by Ixidor to avenge Nivea.
